Container.Name: claude-code
Container.Overview:
Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, running as a persistent toolbox container on Unraid.
Unraid rebuilds its root filesystem from scratch on every boot, so anything installed with npm on the host disappears at reboot. This container keeps Claude Code and — importantly — your login installed permanently.
Start it, then click the container's console button (or run: docker exec -it claude-code claude-code) and type `claude`. Your authentication and settings are stored in appdata and survive restarts, updates and reboots.
Mounted host paths are readable and writable directly — no filesystem MCP server required. Files are created as nobody:users (99:100) by default so they behave like every other file on your array.
WARNING: by default this container mounts /mnt/user read-write, giving Claude Code access to all of your user shares. Adjust the mounts below to narrow that if you prefer.

Config.Name: Appdata (login + settings)
Config.Description: Persistent home directory. Your Claude Code login lives here — without it you would have to re-authenticate every restart. Do not remove.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Default working directory. Claude Code starts here when you open a shell.

Config.Name: User shares
Config.Description: Your array, mounted at the same path it has on the host so /mnt/user/... paths work verbatim. WARNING: this grants read/write access to ALL user shares. To restrict access, change this to a single share (e.g. /mnt/user/media) on both sides, or set the mode to ro.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are created as. 99 (nobody) is the Unraid default — leave it unless you know you need something else.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are created as. 100 (users) is the Unraid default.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File creation mask. Use 000 if you want group/other write access on everything Claude creates.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone, e.g. Europe/London. Keeps timestamps and Claude's sense of 'today' correct.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional. Leave EMPTY to sign in interactively with /login using your Claude subscription (recommended). Only set this if you want to bill usage to an Anthropic Console API key instead.

Config.Name: Update on start
Config.Description: Set to true to npm-update Claude Code on every container start. Off by default — the image ships a recent version, and enabling this makes startup depend on npm being reachable. The normal update path is pulling a newer image.

Config.Name: Run as root
Config.Description: Set to true to skip dropping privileges and run everything as root. Files Claude creates will be root-owned, which other containers usually cannot write. Only enable if you hit a permission problem you cannot solve with PUID/PGID.

Config.Name: Individual disks
Config.Description: Optional. Unassigned Devices mounts, if you want Claude Code to reach them.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional. Lets Claude Code inspect your other containers. WARNING: access to the Docker socket is equivalent to root on the host — anything that can talk to it can take over the server. Read-only (ro) limits it to inspection. Leave blank unless you specifically want this.
